zh.Meta.description: Tell Najimi what you love. It makes things for your real life that fit you — your room relit, dinner for your mum, your next book — and shows the Qloo taste data behind every choice.
zh.Landing.title: The taste copilot.
zh.Landing.howLede: Your taste isn't a genre. Qloo connects what you love across music, film, books, places and brands; Najimi turns that into things you can use.
zh.Landing.steps.love.title: Tell it what you love
zh.Landing.steps.love.body: Three things or more: a book, an artist, a show, a place. Say how much each counts.
zh.Landing.steps.read.title: Qloo reads your taste
zh.Landing.steps.read.body: The words in your taste (aesthetic, mood, food) and picks across ten domains, live, with the reason for each.
zh.Landing.steps.make.title: Najimi makes it real
zh.Landing.steps.make.body: Restyles of your own photos, lighting plans an electrician can install, real products, recipes at the right texture, playlists, places.
zh.Landing.proof: Compare any answer with the same ask without taste: the difference is Qloo.
zh.Landing.footer: Najimi, made for the Qloo hackathon.
